Accountant
The Accountants Office provides accounting services, payroll and benefits management services to all Town departments including Templeton Sewer Department and Templeton Municipal Light & Water.
Templeton Animal Control
Provides hours (daily 7 AM–7 PM), emergency contact (Police Dispatch at 978-939-5638), officer names, and links to services like spay/neuter, rescue databases, and wildlife tips.
Assessors Office
Information & applications for motor vehicle abatements, personal exemptions, tax rates (with historical rates), links to various information on assessments and online tax GIS maps.
Community Services
The Community Services Department encompasses and supports the Boynton Public Library, Cable Commission and TCTV, Senior Services and Senior Center (which houses the Food Pantry), Parks & Recreation Commission, and Veterans Services.
Development Services
Our goal is to help contractors and citizens alike in all matters associated with building and the Building Permit process including inspections for Electrical, Plumbing or Building., Health Inspections, Zoning decisions, Planning Board process, Conservation and Agriculture.
Emergency Management
Find information related to emergency management.
Fire Department
Details the Fire Department’s contact information and a list of permit types and associated fees for services like burning, sprinkler system inspections, oil burner/tank permits, smoke & CO detector inspections, etc.
Highway Department
The Highway department is made up of one superintendent, one secretary, one foreman, six laborers/truck drivers and one mechanic.
Library Offerings
The Library will be closed to the public from March 26 through mid-September as we undertake a large renovation project. Patrons may utilize any of our neighboring town libraries during this period. We look forward to welcoming you all back to our beautifully restored library.  Many thanks to the Ann and Ed Nordfors estate, and the town's Community Preservation Committee for funding this project.
Light and Water Department
Learn more about Light and Water Department on this website.
Police Department
Templeton Police Department homepage – gateway to the agency’s services, news, and contact info for the Town of Templeton, Massachusetts.
Public Services
The Public Services page on the Town of Templeton's website provides information about the services offered by the Public Services Department, including maintenance, roadwork, waste management, and other community infrastructure initiatives.
Senior Services
A no-fee program hub at the Templeton Senior Community Center offering social and educational activities, transportation for errands and medical appointments, volunteer opportunities, information and referrals, and a monthly newsletter, all geared toward supporting and engaging older residents.
Sewer Department
The board is responsible for overseeing the town’s sewer system, policies, and services.
Templeton Community Television
Templeton Community Television's mission is to be an informational and cultural resource for the Templeton area.
Town Administrator
The Town Administrator serves at the pleasure of the Select Board, which appoints him/her, as the Chief Administrative Officer for the Town.
Town Clerk
Provides contact information for the Town Clerk’s office and details on online payment options for dog licenses and vital records.
Town Moderator
The moderator Presides over annual and special town meetings.
Treasurer/Collector
Provides information from the Treasurer/Collector’s Office on tax due dates, excise bill schedules, payment options, fees, and contact details.
Veterans Services
Provides support and resources for veterans in Templeton, including East Templeton, Baldwinville, and Otter River, with contact information for the Veterans Services Director.
